subject: Recap + POC plan: success criteria, timeline & owner matrix
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@finleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + POC plan: success criteria, timeline & owner matrix

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I send a formal POC doc: 

What we heard from FinLeaf today: 
- Primary goal: reduce model inference cost by ~40% for document summarization workloads while keeping latency under 250ms p95.
- Success signals: (1) p95 latency < 250ms for 75% of queries, (2) token cost <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll finalize number after baseline), (3) zero PII leakage in logs and customer data residency in us-east-1.
- Evaluation scope: 1 app service (frontend summarizer), infra (Kubernetes + Redis cache), and security checklist (SOC2 evidence + audit logs).

Proposed short POC (2 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week) — finalize data sample and success criteria; procurement/contract sign-off if required.
2) Week 1 — deploy trial model on Redwood Dedicated in us-east-1, run canonical test set + live traffic sample (shadow).
3) Week 2 — run load + latency tests, compare cost, produce final readout and recommendation.

Ownership (high-level): 
- FinLeaf infra (K8s cluster, network, identity): Rajiv / infra team
- FinLeaf app owner (integration work, sample data): Samantha / app team
- Security/compliance sign-off & evidence: FinLeaf Legal / security
- Redwood: POC infra, model routing, telemetry, and eval scripts (Diego PM + Marissa for SRE ops)

Next actions I propose:
- Samantha: confirm internal owners + attach sample dataset (or pointer to S3) by Thu 6/4.
- Rajiv: confirm whether we can run shadow traffic against staging cluster (yes/no) by Thu 6/4.
- Diego: I will share a POC template and RACI matrix + SOC2 evidence after this email.

Attachments: placeholder POC template will follow (spreadsheet with success criteria and test cases).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if you prefer to walk through the plan.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Diego —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming we are aligned on goals. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Cost target: aiming for ~35–45% reduction vs our current hosted baseline (we'll send the baseline numbers with the sample).
- Latency: 250ms p95 is acceptable; we also want p99 under 480ms if possible.
- Data residency: must remain in us-east-1 and we cannot forward raw docs to third-party storage.

Internal owners: 
- App & integration: me (Samantha) + Dev lead: K. Patel (cc'ed in my internal thread, will add if needed)
- Infra: Rajiv Mehta (cc'd)
- Security & legal: FinLeaf Legal (included)

I will upload the sample dataset to a secure S3 pre-signed link by end of day Thu 6/4 and share the baseline cost numbers. Rajiv, can you confirm whether we can run shadow traffic against staging? Also, legal — we'll need the SOC2 evidence and a DPA; happy to review your template.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a short list of the specific metrics you will report in the final readout (latency p50/p95/p99, tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate, KV-cache efficiency)? That helps us map to our dashboards.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director of Product | FinLeaf

Thanks for the fast reply, Samantha — good notes. Per your ask, below is the metrics list and the attached RACI. I uploaded the POC spreadsheet + a CSV RACI so your team can edit.

Metrics we will report (final readout):
- Latency: p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
- Throughput: requests/sec and median tokens/sec
- Cost: $ per 1k input tokens, and extrapolated monthly cost at your QPS
- Quality regressions: BLEU/ROUGE/ROUGE-L on canonical set + a sample human-rated quality check for 50 examples
- Operational: cache hit rate, average KV cache utilization, model fallback rate, errors per 1k requests

POC timeline (updated):
- Thu 6/4: FinLeaf provides dataset + baseline cost numbers.
- Fri 6/5: Redwood provisions Dedicated trial capacity in us-east-1 and sends connection details.
- Mon 6/8–Wed 6/10: Integration + shadow traffic runs (integration owner: Samantha).
- Thu 6/11–Fri 6/12: Load tests and cost analysis (Redwood + FinLeaf infra).
- Mon 6/15: Final readout (30-min meeting) + recommendation.

POC RACI (high level, attached):
- Responsible: Redwood SRE (Marissa) for provisioning; FinLeaf app for integration data mapping.
- Accountable: Diego (Redwood AE) for overall POC delivery; Samantha for customer-side acceptance.
- Consulted: Neha (Redwood Security) for SOC2 evidence and security checks; Rajiv for infra constraints.
- Informed: FinLeaf Legal + Redwood Sales Ops.

Notes on security: Neha will send a short SOC2 evidence packet and an ingestion checklist. We will not log raw documents; only telemetry and masked tokens unless you authorize otherwise.

Attachments included: POC_RACI_matrix.csv, FinLeaf_POC_Template.xlsx, redwood-soc2-evidence.pdf

Let me know if we should shorten the timeline. Happy to be flexible on integration windows.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
